info.name: Rillet Accounting API Key Reports API

params.name: month
params.description: The month and year to export. Uses ISO-8061 format (YYYY-MM).

params.name: status
params.description: whether to include committed or active entries

params.name: breakdown
params.description: whether annual or monthly breakdowns

params.name: subsidiary_id
params.description: Subsidiary to be used when filtering data

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of rows to return in the page.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor to navigate through the full response.

items.docs:
Returns the ARR waterfall dataset for the requested month with optional breakdown dimensions, subsidiary filters, and pagination cursors for large tenants.
Finance teams use this to explain beginning ARR, new business, expansion, contraction, and churn between periods.

params.name: to_date
params.description: End date for the report period. Uses ISO-8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: subsidiary_id
params.description: Subsidiary to be used when filtering data

items.docs:
Returns a trial balance report for the specified date range.
Required parameters: from_date and to_date (ISO-8601 format YYYY-MM-DD). Both must be provided or the call will fail.
Example: from_date=2024-01-01, to_date=2024-12-31.

params.name: as_of_date
params.description: The date for the point-in-time report. Uses ISO-8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: subsidiary_id
params.description: Subsidiary to be used when filtering data

params.name: breakdown_by
params.description: How to break down the report columns. If not specified, returns a single total column.

items.docs:
Returns a balance sheet report as of the specified date.
Required parameter: as_of_date (ISO-8601 format YYYY-MM-DD). Must be provided or the call will fail.
Example: as_of_date=2024-12-31.

info.name: Lists journal entries with reporting currency amounts

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of rows to return in the page.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor to navigate through the full response.

params.name: subsidiary_id
params.description: Subsidiary to be used when filtering data

params.name: updated.gt
params.description: Filter journal entries updated after this timestamp

params.name: date.gte
params.description: Filter journal entries with a posting date on or after this date (inclusive)

params.name: date.lte
params.description: Filter journal entries with a posting date on or before this date (inclusive)

params.name: account_ids
params.description: Filter journal entries that have at least one line item posting to any of these account ids (comma-separated)

params.name: sort_by
params.description: the field the journal entries should be sorted by descending (either created or updated)

items.docs: Returns journal entries with line item amounts converted to the reporting currency.
